title: Payments API exhausted PostgreSQL connections
content: Symptoms: payment requests returned HTTP 500 and logs reported remaining connection slots are reserved. Confirmed root cause: an application release failed to close database connections on an exception path. Evidence: active connections rose after deployment and application traces showed unreleased connections. Mitigation performed: the on-call team rolled back the release. Long-term fix: close connections reliably and add connection-pool saturation alerts.

title: Orders consumer lag increased after deployment
content: Symptoms: Kafka consumer lag increased after deployment and the consumer group repeatedly rebalanced. Confirmed root cause: synchronous enrichment calls increased batch processing time beyond max.poll.interval.ms. Evidence: processing duration exceeded the poll interval and consumer logs showed poll interval expiration. Mitigation performed: the team rolled back the enrichment change. Long-term fix: reduce processing time, bound external-call timeouts, and tune batch size using load tests.

title: Draft diagnosis of orders consumer lag
content: Unreviewed hypothesis: consumer lag and repeated rebalancing might be caused by an undersized max.poll.interval.ms. This draft proposes changing the interval, but processing-duration evidence has not been collected. The diagnosis and proposed change have not been approved.

title: Orders consumer lag during staging network experiment
content: Symptoms: orders consumer lag increased during a staging experiment. Confirmed root cause: injected network delay slowed broker communication. Evidence: the delay matched the fault-injection window. Resolution: the team ended the staging experiment. This incident does not describe the production deployment.
